lines.text: As His disciples picked heads of grain on the Sabbath, the Sadducees asked Jesus why they were doing what was unlawful.
Jesus said David entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests.
Jesus declared that the Sabbath was made for man, and that the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.
In the synagogue, people watched to see if Jesus would heal a man with a withered hand, and they were silent when He questioned them.
Jesus restored the man's hand, and the Pharisees went out and began plotting with the chief priests how they might kill Him.
